text.en: This Order may be cited as the Criminal Conduct (Recovery of Proceeds) (Amendment) Order, 2007. of section 30 of S 52/00.

Section 30 of the Criminal Conduct !Recovery of Proceeds) Order, 2000 (S 52/2000), in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended(a) in subsection (5),

(i) in paragraph (a)(i) "and drug trafficking" immediately after "criminal conduct", Iii) by inserting in paragraph (a)(ii) "and drug trafficking" immediately after "criminal conduct",

(iii) by inserting in paragraph (a)(iii) "and drug trafficking" immediately after "criminal conduct".

(b) by inserting in subsection (8), the following 2 new definitions immediately after the definition of "asset-sharing agreement11 11 "confiscation order" means a confiscation order made under this Order or under the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Act (Chapter 178), or an external confiscation order registered under this Order or under the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Act (Chapter 178); "drug trafficking" has the same definition as "drug trafficking" in section 2 of the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Act of new section 34A.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 34 - of Attorney General. 34A. Where, in relation to any designated country, no authority has been specified in any order made under 31, a certificate made by the Attorney by notification in the Gazette to the effect that any authority specified therein is the appropriate authority for the purposes of that section and of any other provisions of this Order as modified by this Order, is sufficient evidence of that fact.". Made this 21st. day of Jamadilawal, 1428 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of June, 2007 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

DARUSSALAM AWANG MOHIDIN BIN HAJI DAUD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
